protocol.unit: one 20 m pixel of the EPSG:32630 grid snapped to the Sentinel-2 20 m pixel edges
protocol.imagery: Sentinel-2 L1C top-of-atmosphere reflectance (Earth Search sentinel-2-l1c, scale and offset from raster:bands), 10 m; B11 shown with each 20 m pixel repeated 2x2
protocol.panels: true colour B04/B03/B02 and SWIR false colour B11/B8/B4 over 340 m around the point (x3), true colour over 1 km around it (x1); the pixel sits inside red corner marks
protocol.stretch: reflectance 0 to 1, square root, the same for every date

classes.snow: the marked pixel is covered by snow on most of its area (white in true colour, cyan in SWIR)
classes.no_snow: the marked pixel is clear-sky ground, vegetation, rock or water without snow on most of it
classes.cloud: a cloud, thick haze or cloud veil over the pixel hides the ground (white or grey in both panels)
classes.unsure: a mixed pixel at a snow edge, deep shadow too dark to read, thin haze, or any doubt

rules: labels are the labeller's visual judgement on the chips; no index, threshold or classifier output is computed or looked at
snow in SWIR false colour is cyan or blue (low B11), cloud is white or pink (high B11)
cloud shadow on clear ground is not cloud: label what the ground shows, or unsure if too dark
points were labelled in a shuffled order per date, without their stratum shown
unsure points stay in the file with scored = false and are left out of every score
protocol.labeller: LLM labelling agent (Claude), blind to every snow classifier in the repository

strata.snowline_band: elevation within 200 m of the date's snowline_m
strata.terrain_shadow: cast shadow (rays traced 8000 m towards the sun) or local incidence cosine under 0.174 (80 degrees)
strata.forest: WorldCover tree cover on at least 50% of the pixel
strata.cloud_edge: within 100 m of the SCL cloud / clear-sky boundary
strata.open_terrain: SCL clear sky, no tree cell, not in any other stratum

design.draw: simple random sample per date, stratum and elevation band; quotas split evenly over the dates where the stratum has pixels, then over its elevation bands; strata other than cloud_edge drawn only on SCL clear-sky pixels. Points also carry every stratum they fall in (in_strata) and the pixel count of their draw cell (cell_pixels) for design-weighted estimates.
design.supplement: points with draw = 2 come from a second draw (seed and quotas in metadata.supplement) on the dates with a snowline, from the same strata and elevation bands restricted to ground at or above the date's snowline_m, keeping the minimum spacing to the first draw; their cell_pixels count the restricted cell. They oversample snow-prone ground: weight each draw by its own cells.

sources.sentinel-2-l1c: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L1C via Earth Search (Element 84), AWS Open Data
sources.sentinel-2-c1-l2a: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A collection 1 via Earth Search; scene classes 8, 9, 10 used only to place the cloud-edge stratum, sun angles from item metadata
sources.glo-30: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA, Airbus), AWS Open Data, bilinear to 20 m
sources.worldcover: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (Zanaga et al. 2022), CC BY 4.0, class 10 tree cover

supplement.restriction: elevation at or above the date's snowline_m
